description: Technical scenarios for the scripted_fixture Mode. They are not business Cases: none of them is a Case of the dev or public_check Partition. A script is data read by generic code: each entry is one model turn (a tool call, an answer built from the last tool result, or a raw answer). The tools it calls are the real local tools on the Chinook file.

case.question: Scenario: how many tracks have the genre Rock?

arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

case.question: Scenario: how many artists are in the catalogue?

arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM Album

case.question: Scenario: how many genres are there?

arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS genre_count FROM Genre

script.raw_answer: There are 25 genres in the catalogue.

case.question: Scenario: how many media types are there?

arguments.sql: SELEC COUNT(*) AS media_type_count FROM MediaType
SELECT COUNT(*) AS media_type_count FROM MediaType

case.question: Scenario: how many playlists are there?

arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS playlist_count FROM Playlist

case.question: Scenario: how many employees are there?

arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee
